basis.quote: My usual migraine started this morning — same one-sided throbbing and light sensitivity I always get.
basis.interpretation: Patient reports typical migraine presentation with unilateral throbbing and photophobia consistent with her baseline migraines.

basis.quote: Five minutes ago my right arm suddenly became weak and I cannot speak clearly.
basis.interpretation: Acute onset of right arm weakness and speech difficulty within minutes represents new focal neurological deficit that is NOT consistent with migraine and raises concern for acute stroke, TIA or other acute neurological emergency.

output.reason: Acute focal neurological deficit (arm weakness and dysarthria) is a time-critical emergency requiring immediate evaluation regardless of concurrent migraine.
